senses.sense_definition: een diepe afkeer of walging voelen voor iemand of iets

examples.text: Ik <w>verfoei</w> elke vorm van geweld en oneerlijkheid in het dagelijks leven.

target_lang_translations.en: I <w>abhor</w> every form of violence and dishonesty in daily life.

examples.text: Zij <w>verfoeide</w> de hypocriete houding van haar collega's tijdens de vergadering.

target_lang_translations.en: She <w>loathed</w> the hypocritical attitude of her colleagues during the meeting.

target_lang_definitions.en: to feel a deep aversion, hatred, or disgust towards someone or something

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to feel intense repugnance and disgust toward something
to feel extreme aversion or intense dislike toward someone or something
formal or literary: to hate thoroughly and view as an abomination

senses.sense_definition: met grote verontwaardiging iets afkeuren of veroordelen

examples.text: De partijleider liet weten dat hij het voorgestelde beleid ten zeerste <w>verfoeit</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The party leader made it known that he utterly <w>condemns</w> the proposed policy.

examples.text: Vele intellectuelen <w>verfoeiden</w> die beslissing van de autoritaire regering.

target_lang_translations.en: Many intellectuals <w>denounced</w> that decision by the authoritarian government.

target_lang_definitions.en: to condemn or reject something with great indignation

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to strongly and publicly condemn something
to express utter disapproval of something
to strongly reject or oppose something on moral grounds
